Recovered MLX observed prefill is a median of rounded first-token chat-event rates within each trial, not aggregate request throughput. Exact MLX prefill duration and granted context remain unknown. macOS GPU utilization/memory are unavailable, not zero. System RAM is machine-wide; process RSS is sampled.
